{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float: remove commas and cast
# First, check for the 999999.99 QA orders
print("Rows with revenue == '999999.99'", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())

# Remove QA orders
df_clean = df[df['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Convert revenue to float
df_clean['revenue'] = df_clean['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Now focus on converted == 1
converted_df = df_clean[df_clean['converted'] == 1]

# Check for -1 in customer_age
print("Number of converted customers with age -1:", (converted_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Compute mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Check if there are any -1s in the converted group
if (converted_df['customer_age'] == -1).sum() > 0:
    print("Note: There are customers with age -1 in the converted group. These are missing values.")
    # We will remove them before computing mean
    converted_valid = converted_df[converted_df['customer_age'] != -1]
    mean_age_converted = converted_valid['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers (excluding -1 and QA/refunded orders): {mean_age_converted}")"}
